question: Which of the following initiatives of the Government of India promises 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to all the rural households who volunteer to do unskilled manual work?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) was enacted in September 2005.
 
• The scheme aims to enhance the livelihood security of people in rural areas by guaranteeing 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to a rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• MGNREGS covers all districts of India except for those that have a 100% urban population.
 
• The scheme is demand-driven, meaning work is provided when it is demanded by the rural households.
 
• It aims to create durable assets and strengthen the livelihood resource base of the rural poor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Funding Pattern**

 
 
• The cost of wages for unskilled manual workers is shared between the Central and State Governments in a 90:10 ratio.
 
• The central government bears the full cost of wages for semi-skilled and skilled workers and material costs.
 
 
 
• **Implementation**
 
 
• MGNREGS is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) in association with state governments.
 
• The Gram Panchayats are the principal authorities for planning and implementation of the scheme at the grassroots level.
 
 
 
• **Social Audit**
 
 
• Social audits are conducted by the Gram Sabha to ensure transparency and accountability in the implementation of the scheme.
 
• Social audits involve a public process where the work done by the Gram Panchayat is scrutinized by the community.
 
 
 
• **Impact**
 
 
• MGNREGS has significantly contributed to poverty alleviation, especially among marginalized communities.
 
• The scheme has also been instrumental in creating rural infrastructure and improving access to basic amenities.
